metadata.title: Idaho Public Fishing Waters and Access Points
metadata.scope: Officially documented Idaho Fish and Game public-access waters and active IDFG-managed or co-managed fishing/boating access sites.
metadata.important_limit: No statewide source proves every lawful access point managed by every federal, tribal, county, city, irrigation, utility, or private-easement owner. Records without explicit public-access evidence are excluded.

access_points.access_details: Visitors have two options to access Valley Creek. From State Highway 21, approximately 8.5 miles west of Stanley, take the M-M Sportsman Access turn and drive .8 mile. Offsite camping is available at nearby Sawtooth National Recreational Area campgrounds.

access_points.access_details: This access is a partnership between the City of Challis and IFG which provides convenient access for persons with disabilities and accessible family fishing within walking distance of downtown Challis. Follow 2nd Street South to the end of the road and take the paved path to the pond. You will find sheltered picnic tables and benches arranged around the pond. The pond is stocked with rainbow trout as well as excess hatchery steelhead in the spring.

access_points.access_details: This access provides roadside parking along State Highway 21 within easy walking distance to Valley Creek. access_points.access_details: This 9-acre Sawtooth National Recreational Area access is located alongside State Highway 75 and offers easy parking for six or eight vehicles just walking distance from the Salmon River. Limited camping space and turnarounds are available. Please respect the private property that borders this access.
access_points.official_source_name: IDFG Fishing and Boating Access Sites Public

access_points.access_details: A short hike from the parking area along a well–maintained trail takes you to Jimmy Smith Lake. From there, an unimproved trail along the north side of the lake takes you to BLM and Forest Service lands. It is a popular year-round trout fishing and fall hunting destination. Camping is limited to two dispersed sites along the 2- mile access road which forks off the East Fork Road. Turnaround space and RV camping is limited at the trailhead parking area.from the lake provides foot and horse access only to adjacent federal lands.
access_points.official_source_name: IDFG Fishing and Boating Access Sites Public

access_points.access_details: This 198-acre access provides abundant fishing, hunting, and wildlife viewing opportunities. A disabled fishing platform is located at the southwest access. Check the “Special Rules Waters” section of the Idaho Fishing Seasons and Rules for restrictions on the Pahsimeroi River. Short-range weapons only are allowed during all hunting seasons. Please stay within the posted boundaries out of respect for our ranching neighbors.

access_points.access_details: This is an IFG public easement through private land that provides a natural boat ramp to the Salmon River and accesses BLM lands. Wildlife viewing opportunities are numerous here. Please respect adjacent private properties and stay within the posted boundaries.
access_points.official_source_name: IDFG Fishing and Boating Access Sites Public

access_points.access_details: This public fishing pond is provided for the enjoyment of our young anglers. Please observe the following. Fishing Rules: State fishing rules and regulations apply. Please consult the current Idaho Fishing Seasons and Rules Book (available at the hatchery or any local license vendor) for additional information. Age Restrictions: This pond is for children 17 years of age and under. Parking Information: Parking is restricted to the visitor parking lots. Fishing Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Some fishing equipment is available. Please inquire at the office.
access_points.official_source_name: IDFG Fishing and Boating Access Sites Public

access_points.access_details: This 8-acre access has a pond which is occasionally stocked with rainbow trout during the summer fishing season, especially for the Memorial Day and July 4th holidays. Water for the pond is from a secondary water right, so the pond is periodically drawn down by irrigators during the summer. A 150-foot walk from the parking area is required to access the pond. Limited camping space is available at the Squaw Creek Access located just east of the US Highway 93 and Squaw Creek Road junction. Daylight Use Only.
access_points.official_source_name: IDFG Fishing and Boating Access Sites Public

access_points.access_details: This IFG foot access-only easement across private land offers fishing access to Valley Creek. The easement extends approximately 400 feet east of the bridge on the south bank of Valley Creek. Please stay within the posted easement boundaries. Daylight use only.
